artifact: Security mutation journal entries and snapshot: host/audit/mutations/{journal.cborseq, snapshot.cbor}
authority: 1-architecture/5-architecture-server-host-audit.md#security-mutation-transaction (the steps and their recovery), owner decision of 2026-10-07 (labels, types, cardinalities); crates/permguard-host/src/operations/journal.rs (Entry, encode_snapshot)
encoding: deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 core deterministic), integers in the signed 64-bit range

fields.name: operation_id
fields.note: exactly 16 bytes, from the OS random source

fields.name: action
fields.note: the registered security audit action its records carry

fields.name: initiator
fields.note: the authorization principal, or the Host process: `expiry`, `bootstrap`, `cli`

fields.name: request_id
fields.note: the caller's idempotency key; present with label 10

fields.name: request_digest
fields.note: SHA-256 of the request, hex; present with label 9

fields.name: target
fields.note: what it is done to, when known before it is applied

fields.name: revision
fields.note: the revision the domain mutation produced

fields.name: result
fields.note: the answer a retry learns, as its domain wrote it; absent when recovery wrote the commit

fields.name: reconciled
fields.note: true when recovery wrote the commit from what the domain shows

fields.name: kind
fields.note: `projected`: the audit record of the outcome is durable

fields.name: entries
fields.note: the canonical bytes of the entries that rebuild the live operations
